_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 35 recent windows showing ±2+ point movement, the coil is intact and HOLD is the statistically honest default until a confirmed breaker emerges in ETF flows or momentum.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing his false-breakout track record; narrative implies bullish resolution but does not commit to a direction, creating an asymmetry in conviction
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustain above 90 AND btc_momentum_30d breaks above 60 with funding staying below 60
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 80 with dxy_weakness dropping below 50 AND mvrv_zscore falling below 15
